mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen each of the last two weeks (-84.9 to -71.3 to -66.3), indicating self-reinforcing recovery momentum as consumers resume discretionary shopping trips; this momentum persists over the next four weeks absent new restrictions.
evidence_refs: fact:two consecutive weekly increases from -84.9 to -66.3
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the mean over the last 28 days despite the prior two-week upward trend continuing unbroken at decision time.

mechanism_narrative: A large single-week jump in PARKS mobility (from -76.4 to -36.3, +40 points) reflects an official easing of outdoor-gathering restrictions; such policy relaxation typically extends to retail settings within two weeks, lifting RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises more than 30 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the subsequent two weeks even though PARKS showed a sudden jump exceeding 30 points at the prior observation.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous recovery in WORKPLACES (-66.0 to -43.1) and TRANSIT (-82.1 to -65.0) indicates renewed commuting behavior; commuters make incidental retail stops en route, so joint increases in both series compound to drive RETAIL_REC higher over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both rise week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:both series improved in t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines or stagnates over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both rising concurrently for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility remains elevated (+20.6 at t-0w) as Victoria enters early Southern Hemisphere winter, suggesting continued time spent at home due to weather and caution; this seasonal stickiness dampens the pace of RETAIL_REC recovery over the next four weeks relative to the reopening-driven surge seen previously.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL still +20.6 above baseline at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues to rise at the same or faster pace than the prior four weeks despite RESIDENTIAL staying above +15 and seasonal cooling underway.

mechanism_narrative: A plateau in RESIDENTIAL mobility (week-on-week change shrinking from -8.1 to -2.4) signals that the pool of people staying home for precaution is saturating; once this plateau threshold is crossed, residual suppressed demand shifts toward retail trips within one week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL week-on-week absolute change falls below 3 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise in the week following a RESIDENTIAL week-on-week change under 3 points, or RESIDENTIAL resumes larger declines without a retail uptick.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility has stabilized near -36 after sharp improvement, implying essential-trip demand is saturated under current staged-reopening policy; freed household trip budget reallocates toward discretionary retail, raising RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM nearly flat between t-1w (-37.7) and t-0w (-35.9)
regime_hint: staged reopening phase with essential-trip saturation
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase over the next two weeks even though GROCERY_PHARM remains stable within a 2-point band.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT and RETAIL_REC have moved together closely over the last two weeks (both improving roughly 15 points); this tight coupling reflects shared trip-chaining behavior, so a continued rise in TRANSIT in the coming week should immediately co-move with a rise in RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by more than 5 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and RETAIL_REC both improved roughly in tandem from t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise in the week immediately following a TRANSIT increase exceeding 5 points, breaking the assumed coupling.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has steadily approached baseline, serving as a leading indicator of broader public mobility normalization; this general easing of movement restrictions propagates to retail footfall over a two-week lag as confidence in outdoor and shared spaces grows.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over the next two weeks despite PARKS continuing its sustained upward trajectory toward baseline.
